scope.summary: Implement the remaining triggers on StudioPrototypeFlow: on drag (with continuous movement mapping for swipeable UI); key/gamepad (a key, key combination, or controller button); after delay (a frame-level dwell timer for splash screens/autoplay/timed states); and media timestamp/end (a media-bearing layer reaching a set timestamp or ending playback). These bind into the same trigger model + inspector as MT-375; runtime firing is deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: drag + key/gamepad + after-delay + media timestamp/end triggers fire deterministically
expected_tests: live: drag maps continuous movement; key/combo/controller fires; after-delay dwell timer fires; media timestamp/end fires

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No drag/key/timer/media triggers; swipe, keyboard, timed, and media prototypes impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
